_comment: P2-074 (GPU DLG-2 1 Nov, mapped 5.78: 'Resident Nalia: the camera faces a bare slope with no NPC in frame'; path 'place Nalia with a stand beside her body'). When enabled, scripts/world/water_npc_placement.gd moves her to the flat ground at the foot of that wall, about 2 m from the post stand; the body, the host's speech step and the grass clearance all read the same offset. Dialogue, flags and rewards unchanged. OFF until GPU judged.
